messages:
emma (support): Hey team — customer (acct: acme-corp) is getting 400s from /v1/rerank. They pasted the error: `400 Bad Request: validation_error: 'candidates' must be a non-empty array`. Request ID: req_01GZ7X4K.

josh (customer): FYI I'm hitting this after upgrading to sdk-js v2.4. They only changed the body shape. Happens on both staging and prod.

emma (support): Can you paste the exact payload?

josh (customer): Sure, this is what we send now (redacted):
```json
{
  "query": "Which article is better?",
  "candidates": "12345",
  "model": "rerank-v1"
}
```

cleo (support): aha — candidates should be an array of strings/objects, not a single string. That will trip the validation. The old SDK serialized arrays differently, maybe a regression.

emma (support): Repro steps for us: curl example that reproduces their 400:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"Which is better?","candidates":"12345"}'
```
Response:
```json
{ "error": "validation_error", "message": "candidates must be an array" }
```

mike (eng-ml): @emma thanks for the repro. Do we have schema-level validation logs for req_01GZ7X4K?

emma (support): @mike attaching server-side validation snippet from request log: `schema_check failed: field candidates type string != expected array`. Also saw similar error for another customer where `queries` was provided as `{}` not `["text"]`.

sanjay (eng-runtime): Two quick checks: 1) Content-Type header must be application/json — missing header can trigger body parsing fallback in some routing layers. 2) Empty arrays are valid shape but we return 400 if candidates is an empty array: `candidates must contain at least 1 item`.

cleo (support): Customer also reported weird scores (all zeros) when they did provide candidates array but items were empty objects `[]` vs `["id1"]`. Could be downstream ranking returning default score when features missing.

emma (support): Action items: 1) Ask customer to send the exact JSON and header dump. 2) Provide quick patch for SDK: validate types before sending. 3) Escalate to eng-ml if input looks correct but we still 400.

josh (customer): Here's header dump from our client: `Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxx`, `Content-Type: application/json`. We send through our node client which builds body from `payload.candidates` (used to be array). Rolling back to pinned version fixes it.

mike (eng-ml): Thanks. Could be SDK v2.4 introduced a bug when serializing arrays in some edge cases (e.g., single-element arrays become scalar). @sanjay can we search logs for `schema_check failed: field candidates type string` in last 7 days?

sanjay (eng-runtime): Running query now, returning ~12 matches across 5 customers. Most follow pattern: body.candidates is a string or null. I pushed filter to reject scalar candidates earlier but apparently not in all code paths.

emma (support): I'm opening INC-20123 and linking this thread. Triage note: likely SDK regression; temporary mitigation: advise customers to pin to sdk-js v2.3 and validate candidate type.

cleo (support): Posting suggested customer message: "We saw your request body contains candidates as a string — please send as array, e.g. `[\"id1\", \"id2\"]` or objects `[{\"id\":\"id1\"}]`. If you still get 400 after that, reply with full request body and request_id.` :thumbsup:

josh (customer): Will try pinning, will share results in ~30m. Thanks.

incident-bot: Escalation created: INC-20123 assigned to eng-ml. Priority: P2.

mike (eng-ml): Follow-up from my side: if we confirm SDK regression, we should add server-side defensive validation that returns clearer message including field path and type (e.g., `candidates: expected array of strings, got string`). Also logging the original content-type and raw body for debugging.

emma (support): Agreed. I'll keep the customer updated. If customer still hits 400 with correct array, please @mention me and I'll reopen with the ticket.

josh (customer): Confirmed pin -> works. Rolling back for now. Thanks for the quick help.

cleo (support): Marking this as customer-resolved. Leaving open in INC-20123 to track SDK fix + runtime defensive improvements.

emma (support): Notes for postmortem: common causes for rerank 400s: missing required fields (queries/candidates), wrong types (string vs array), empty arrays, invalid candidate object shapes, and missing Content-Type header. Add a short doc snippet to support KB with curl examples and SDK validation tips.

mike (eng-ml): I'll add a unit test that ensures arrays don't collapse to scalars in serialization and a server test that rejects scalars with explicit error messages.

cleo (support): Thanks everyone. Closing thread for now.
